english.title: Entertainment provider fail to provide for the safety of children at event
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person providing in a building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), entertainment

(A)_[for children]_
(B)_[at which the majority of persons attending were children]_

and at which the number of children attending the entertainment exceeded one hundred, failed to

(C)_[station and keep stationed wherever necessary a sufficient number of adult attendants, properly instructed as to their duties to prevent more children or other persons being admitted to the building than the building could accommodate]_
(D)_[station and keep stationed wherever necessary a sufficient number of adult attendants, properly instructed as to their duties to prevent more children or other persons being admitted to part of the building, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..), than that part could accommodate]_
(E)_[control the movement of the children and other persons admitted while entering and leaving the building]_
(F)_[control the movement of the children and other persons admitted while entering and leaving part of the building, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..)]_
(G)_[take reasonable precautions for the safety of the children]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) and (3) of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to fulfil an obligation
imposed by s.12 CYPA 1933

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This section shall not apply to any entertainment given in a private dwelling-house.
